title: A sheep that escaped was finally caught by 13-year-old who chased it on horseback
summary_full: In Wadsworth, a runaway American Blackbelly sheep managed to elude capture for more than 45 days, igniting community spirit. Residents banded together, sharing sightings and attempting various capture techniques. Eventually, a determined teenager named Reagan succeeded in roping the sheep after an extensive chase. The sheep now resides at a sanctuary, symbolizing the unity and proactive involvement of the community, which also welcomed new volunteers.
